candidate_role_authority.candidate_fingerprint: Hash canonical JSON of {root_role,terminal_guard_operand_index,steps:[{kind,token_digest_sha256}]}, exactly the Gate2C5 identity schema but independently derived.
candidate_role_authority.candidate_projection_steps: Independently trace straight-line aliases from the exact source-role root to the exact frozen guard operand. Admit only ATTRIBUTE and SUBSCRIPT_LITERAL steps. Alias variable spelling is excluded from identity.
candidate_role_authority.guard_terminal_authority: Use only the frozen Gate2C2a semantic_slice.source_contract exact target_function_span, guard anchor span, and effective_if_span. No nearest-compare or name fallback.
candidate_role_authority.root_parameter_authority: For each selected case, use only the frozen Gate2C2a adapter_receipt.execution_signature.source_roles role->parameter_index mapping. Source parameter spelling has zero semantic authority.
candidate_role_authority.token_identity: ATTRIBUTE token = SHA-256 exact UTF-8 attribute token; SUBSCRIPT_LITERAL token = SHA-256 canonical JSON bytes of literal key. Emit digest only; never interpret token spelling as domain meaning.

claim_boundary.allowed: State exact candidate-vs-canonical opaque projection identity match/mismatch counts and decomposed mismatch family within the seven frozen development cases.
forbidden: claiming VALID_C1 or final selective coverage gain
calling the seven cases heldout/fresh evidence

classification_contract.CANONICAL_OPAQUE_PROJECTION_MATCH: Root role authority, terminal operand index, projection shape, step kinds, opaque token digests, and recomputed full fingerprint all exactly match Gate2C5 canonical authority.
classification_contract.FULL_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: All decomposed fields appear equal but recomputed full canonical fingerprint does not equal Gate2C5 fingerprint; fail closed as internal consistency failure.
classification_contract.GUARD_OR_SCOPE_RESOLUTION_FAILURE: Exact frozen target function, guard compare, or effective-if surface cannot be uniquely resolved.
classification_contract.PROJECTION_SHAPE_MISMATCH: Independently derived candidate projection step count/shape differs from Gate2C4/Gate2C5 shape.
classification_contract.PROJECTION_STEP_KIND_MISMATCH: Step cardinality agrees but one or more projection kinds differ from canonical authority.
classification_contract.PROJECTION_TOKEN_DIGEST_MISMATCH: Root, operand, shape, and step kinds agree, but one or more opaque projection-token digests differ.
classification_contract.ROOT_PARAMETER_ORIGIN_MISMATCH: Candidate operand independently traces to a parameter index other than the execution-signature source-role parameter index, or root is unresolved/nonunique.
classification_contract.TERMINAL_OPERAND_INDEX_MISMATCH: Frozen role terminal operand index is unavailable, out of range, or inconsistent with the required expected=0/current=1 contract.

decision_rule.next_if_14_of_14: A separate prospective Gate2C7 may design projection-qualified C1 origin normalization. It may not use generic .slot stripping.
decision_rule.next_if_not_14_of_14: Do not repair C1; diagnose the exact mismatch family first.
decision_rule.partial_match: Report exact numerator/14; no extrapolation, no repair authorization.
decision_rule.repair_hypothesis_authorized_only_if: All 14/14 role observations are CANONICAL_OPAQUE_PROJECTION_MATCH and independent checker agrees byte-for-byte on fingerprints.

independence_contract.independent_checker: Separately implemented checker must rederive the 14 candidate fingerprints from the same frozen inputs without importing tracer or Gate2C5 builder.
negative_tests: same root + same depth + different attribute token => token mismatch
same root + same depth + different subscript literal => token mismatch
attribute versus subscript with same depth => step-kind mismatch
canonical authority digest corruption => fail closed
population not exactly seven => fail closed
independence_contract.tracer: stdlib Python AST only; may not import C1, primary semantic packages, Gate2C5 builder, or Gate2C3 analyzer.

purpose: Falsify or confirm whether the exact seven frozen SYN-PY-01 Python development cases that stopped at C1 world evaluation carry the same opaque structural guard-operand projection identities as the independently frozen Gate2C5 canonical authority, without modifying or rerunning C1.

read_boundary.source_localization: Reuse Gate2C3 opaque localization semantics: exactly 58 candidate source files may be stream-hashed solely for opaque localization; nonselected bytes may not be parsed, logged, retained, or passed to the diagnostic. Exactly seven selected Python source byte strings may be retained and parsed.
